selection: Within each scope, lowest pooled development observed-cell MAE; select median14/28/56 separately. Freeze before test predictions. Test the selected neural candidate with the fixed arithmetic mean of all three seeds; retain every seed result.
stable_definition: Test pooled MAE strictly lower than the development-selected median, all six test-window MAEs no worse, and all three seed pooled MAEs lower. Report 14-day total AE separately; do not reinterpret this as independent-window significance.
missing: Missing SKU-days are unknown, never training zeros. SKU eligibility uses >=28 observed dates in prior56 calendar dates. Score only future observed cells and report coverage. Never use future record masks to construct national forecasts.
national_scope: Direct forecast of daily sum of recorded qty_alipay, with changing recorded assortment. Not latent demand or full-market sales.
calendar: Known future weekdays, annual sin/cos, fixed November11/December12 indicators. No future behavior or realized paid/order fields.
audit_visibility: Whole-data integrity audit inspected dates, coverage and extreme targets before this configuration. This is a historical time evaluation with frozen model settings, not a prospective blind test.
